design.primary_comparison: Correction release, memory timing, frequency allocation and patternROI-guided routing with supplied annotation; same-run U25 per-step RMS for both spectral arms

preregistration.primary: edit_ok AND subject_ok AND pattern_ok AND NOT artifact; all planned edits remain in denominator
preregistration.comparison: U25_KV/OFF: memory; U25_MID: memory window [7,14); S25_W050/ROUTE25: spectral allocation with same-run U25 realized per-step RMS; REF25_KV: source field at reference rather than edited state.
preregistration.budget: S25_W050 and ROUTE25 consume matching completed same-run U25_KV steps.json; identical sigma/h. Route q=.5*L(c)+M_roi*(c-L(c)), kernel5 replicate average; global update unchanged. M_roi uses the existing fixed pattern_roi annotation, 16px inward linear feather in 512 coordinates, area-downsampled at the actual resolution and channel-replicated/packed.
preregistration.cost: Standalone NFE including 28 inversion calls: U25_KV=91,U25_OFF=84,U25_MID=91,S25_W050=91,ROUTE25=91,REF25_KV=84. Total 7448; spectral arms share the already scheduled U25 reference (91 per task/seed), no extra forward calls for matching. Actual counts recorded.
preregistration.annotation: Blind edit/subject/pattern/artifact labels, unscored stays pending; no VLM credential needed.
preregistration.selection: Select global setting by joint success, then edit success and lower NFE. No task-wise cherry-picking. Confirm selected configuration on independent sources before larger benchmark.
preregistration.reporting: Native lossless PNG metrics; export compact thumbnails and scalar step summaries. Dog tasks share a source. Report task effects and uncertain judgments explicitly.
preregistration.result_status: Implemented; GPU generation and optional CLIP/DINO evaluation pending.

delivery.public_package: thumbnails, sheets, metrics, review, scalar step summaries and frozen reference previews
delivery.native_outputs: R77_ReleaseRouting/results on server only; raw PNG and full traces excluded from public ZIP

warnings: ROUTE25 is patternROI-guided: existing metric pattern_roi is supplied annotation and an extra routing input; outer.png is not used for routing.
Seven tasks use six independent sources; dog tasks share one source.
src_steps is an exclusive end index; MID [7,14) contains seven steps.
Spectral RMS matching depends on the completed same-run U25_KV; no frozen-reference or analytic budget substitution.
